blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — The number of fatalities in the explosion and fire that gutted a suspected illegal fireworks factory in the Pangasinan town of Malasiqui rose to five. The increase in number happened after authorities retrieved the body of another victim at the blast site. The newly-discovered remains join two minors and two adults who belonged to the family renting the property in the boundary of Barangays Tabo-Sili and Calbueg. The information came from Malasiqui Vice Mayor Daria Dolores Mamaril on Wednesday night (November 4). Residents said they heard a loud explosion, followed by bursts of flames at 7:45 pm. The […]...
